title: Chelated Trace Minerals

sections.heading: Chelated Trace Minerals
sections.text: Dairy cattle require optimal levels of trace minerals for reproductive performance, immunity, and milk production. Conventional mineral sources often suffer from poor absorption, leading to suboptimal performance and increased metabolic waste. Chelated Trace Minerals uses advanced Hydroxy amino acid based green chelation technology to secure trace minerals such as copper, manganese, zinc, iron, and chromium thereby enhancing their bioavailability and ensuring efficient metabolic integration. *Project supported by the Technology Development Board, Government of India Components Copper 0.35% Manganese 0.125% Zinc 0.8% Ferrous 0.125% *also available in customized blends based on herd-specific requirements
